meta.purpose: Expanded demo catalogue for developing the Leebazz storefront
warnings: This is demo data, not a verified live inventory.
Prices and stock counts are fictional and must be replaced before launch.
Image URLs are placeholders and may repeat or not exactly match the product name.
Skincare ingredient, skin-type, hair-type, and usage information is placeholder content; verify all claims and labels before sale.
meta.title: Leebazz Import-Ready Demo Catalog
meta.description: 750 imported demo products mapped to the Leebazz catalog product structure. Prices and stock are fictional development values; verify product details, image rights and availability before launch.
notes: Demo prices and stock values are placeholders, not verified selling prices or live inventory.
Each product has one Standard variant so existing SKU-based cart/order/inventory logic can use the imported stock without inventing size-level quantities.
isActive is true for all imported products because the current Leebazz catalog loader filters inactive products.
Product subcategory IDs and category links follow each product?s source subcategory; pullovers are split from sweaters using the source product type.
Image URLs are external source URLs; availability and permission to use them are not guaranteed.
The source dataset contains limited true skincare and kids products; review category assignments before launch.
Homepage featuredProductIds were refreshed to reference products in this 750-product catalog.
